command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

bcftools --version > bcfver.txt 2>&1
BV=$(awk 'NR==1{print $2}' bcfver.txt)
PROT=$(awk 'NR==1{print $1}' protein.txt)

echo "== second annotator, same reference, same GFF, same VCF =="
bgzip -c genes.gff > genes.gff.gz
bcftools csq -f chrA.fa -g genes.gff.gz -l -Ov variants.vcf > csq.vcf 2> csq.log
grep -v '^##' csq.vcf | cut -f3,8
NC=$(awk '!/^#/{n++} END{print n+0}' csq.vcf)
test "$NC" = "5" || { echo "expected 5 records, got $NC"; cat csq.log; exit 1; }
NB=$(awk '!/^#/ && $8 ~ /BCSQ=/ {n++} END{print n+0}' csq.vcf)
test "$NB" = "5" || { echo "only $NB of 5 records carry a BCSQ consequence -- the GFF was not indexed"; cat csq.log; exit 1; }

echo "== normalise bcftools' spelling into the same five columns =="
cat > norm-bcsq.awk <<'AWKEOF'
BEGIN{FS="\t"; OFS="\t"}
!/^#/{
  b=""; n=split($8,parts,";")
  for(i=1;i<=n;i++) if (parts[i] ~ /^BCSQ=/) b=substr(parts[i],6)
  split(b,f,"|")
  csq=f[1]; sub(/&.*/,"",csq); gsub(/^[^A-Za-z]+/,"",csq)
  aa=f[6]; pos="."; r="."; a="."
  if (aa ~ /^[0-9]+[A-Z*]>[0-9]+[A-Z*]$/) {
    split(aa,s,">"); pos=s[1]; gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",pos)
    r=s[1]; gsub(/[0-9]/,"",r); a=s[2]; gsub(/[0-9]/,"",a)
  } else if (aa ~ /^[0-9]+[A-Z*]$/) {                # synonymous: one token, no '>'
    pos=aa; gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",pos); r=aa; gsub(/[0-9]/,"",r); a=r
  }
  print $3, csq, pos, r, a
}
AWKEOF
awk -f norm-bcsq.awk csq.vcf | sort > bcsq.norm
cat bcsq.norm

echo "== vs the planted truth, and vs snpEff on identical bytes =="
if diff -q truth.tsv bcsq.norm  >/dev/null; then BEXACT=yes; else BEXACT=no; diff truth.tsv bcsq.norm  || true; fi
if diff -q snpeff.norm bcsq.norm >/dev/null; then AGREE=yes;  else AGREE=no;  diff snpeff.norm bcsq.norm || true; fi
test "$BEXACT" = yes
test "$AGREE"  = yes

echo "== the frameshift: bcftools spells out the new reading frame, so the OLD one is assertable =="
RAWFS=$(awk -F'\t' '$3=="v4_fs"{split($8,p,"BCSQ="); split(p[2],f,"|"); print f[6]}' csq.vcf)
REFPEP=${RAWFS%%>*}; REFPEP=${REFPEP##[0-9]}; REFPEP=${REFPEP##[0-9]}
EXPPEP=${PROT:32}
echo "bcftools ref peptide from codon 33: $REFPEP   designed protein tail: $EXPPEP"
if [ "$REFPEP" = "$EXPPEP" ]; then FSPEP=yes; else FSPEP=no; fi
test "$FSPEP" = yes

echo "== the raw spellings, side by side (observation, not assertion) =="
{
printf 'variant\tsnpEff\tbcftools csq\n'
for v in v1_syn v2_mis v3_non v4_fs v5_spl; do
  S=$(awk -F'\t' -v v="$v" '$3==v{split($8,p,"ANN="); split(p[2],f,"|"); printf "%s / %s", f[2], (f[11]==""?"-":f[11])}' ann.vcf)
  B=$(awk -F'\t' -v v="$v" '$3==v{split($8,p,"BCSQ="); split(p[2],f,"|"); printf "%s / %s", f[1], (f[6]==""?"-":f[6])}' csq.vcf)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$v" "$S" "$B"
done
} | tee conventions.txt

{
printf 'Variant annotation -- two annotators on one reference, one GFF, one VCF\n'
printf 'bcftools_version\t%s\n' "$BV"
printf 'records_with_consequence\t%s of 5   (assert 5 -- a mis-parsed GFF yields records with no BCSQ at all)\n' "$NB"
printf 'bcftools_exact\t%s   (assert yes -- EXACT vs planted consequences)\n' "$BEXACT"
printf 'annotators_agree\t%s   (assert yes -- cross-validation after normalising the two spellings)\n' "$AGREE"
printf 'frameshift_ref_frame\t%s   (assert yes -- bcftools ref peptide from codon 33 equals the designed protein tail %s)\n' "$FSPEP" "$EXPPEP"
printf 'note\tthe two agree on every consequence; the RAW strings share almost no notation -- see conventions.txt\n'
} | tee smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
